name: Abigail Spanberger
bio: a Representative from Virginia; born in Red Bank, Monmouth County, N.J., August 7, 1979; graduated from J.R. Tucker High School, Henrico, Va.; United States Capitol Page School, 1996; B.A., University of Virginia, Charlottesville, Va., 2001; M.B.A., Purdue University, 2002; teacher; postal inspector, United States Postal Service; case officer, Central Intelligence Agency, 2006-2014; consultant; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Sixteenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2019-January 3, 2025); was not a candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress in 2024; Governor of Virginia, 2026-present.
